content:
tanya: Quick sync — we need a concise ownership map and blockers for the semver bump of our generation endpoint (moving clients to API 2.0) before we lock the migration window. Who's taking what? Please reply with owners + any hard blockers by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kai: SDK side update — python/js PRs are ready but waiting on auth token schema. PR examples: github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/142 and github.com/redwood/sdk-py/pull/88. Need header contract finalization.

jordan: Infra note — proxy can route by header or param but we need a stable token claim to route safely at edge. I can own the route config once auth gives the claim name.

auth-team-bot: Auth migration RFC posted: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/auth/token-v2. Proposed date: 2026-04-02 for token v2 acceptance window.

mike: I'll own the rollout for edge routing and feature flag gating. Plan to add a flag `enable_api2_routes`. Blocker: exact token claim + a short canary slice.

amanda: SDK release plan: ship minor that reads `X-Api-Version` (and falls back to `api_version` query param). We will publish a changelog and a 30-day shim. ETA for releases: 2026-03-28 if token change is confirmed.

kai: One ask — can we support fallback to query param? some enterprise customers inject version via query strings.

jordan: Yes, we'll accept both. Proxy config draft: 
```
# proxy match snippet
if header("X-Api-Version") == "2" or query_param("api_version") == "2":
  route_to("api-v2-pool")
else:
  route_to("api-v1-pool")
```
I'll run a small smoke test after infra change.

dennis: Telemetry heads-up — add `api_version` tag to all request events so we can track error rates by version. I'll add a pipeline job and a dashboard tile.

tanya: Ownership summary so far: infra routing (jordan + mike), SDK releases (kai + amanda), auth/token change (sasha), telemetry (dennis). Blockers: auth token claim + finalized canary slice. Anyone disagree or add owners?

sasha: Sasha here — ack. I can move token rollout up one week if that helps; will confirm by EOD with exact claim name (likely `ver` or `ver_v2`).

sdk-release-bot: Reminder: update SDK changelogs and release notes when PRs merge. Templates: /docs/releases/sdk-template.md

kai: I'll link PRs and add a migration snippet to the SDK README (example header usage + fallback).

tanya: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate this into the migration doc and open a follow-up thread for the canary schedule once auth confirms. If you haven't acked, please react with :thumbsup: or reply with blockers.
